🏌️‍♂️ THE TAKOMO D2 DRIVER HAS ARRIVED AT BHR! 🔥

Want to see what the hype is about? The Takomo D2 Driver is now available at Bat Hill Royale for players to test.

The driver can only be tested when you book a Takomo club fitting. Step into the bay, put it to the test on TrackMan, and see how it performs with your own swing. 💥⛳

📍 Bat Hill Royale
🎯 Book your Takomo club fitting to test the D2 Driver
🏌️ Compare your numbers. Feel the difference. Find your fit.
